_comment: Display config for Country X, a FICTIONAL demonstration country (project-defined, not a primary source). Purpose: demo the full coherence dashboard without exposing pilot-country data. The corpus is real published policy-target text pooled from several countries' documents (dev_data_scripts/mock_targets_14aug26.xlsx, built by dev_data_scripts/ingest_countryx_14aug26.py) and de-identified by hand-curated edits listed in that script — no LLM-drafted text anywhere in this config or the corpus. Coherence-only (Level 1): no BTR / BER / NR7 data, so no btrMitigationSourceRef, countrySectors, or mitigationTaxonomy.
name: Country X
_anchorDocTypeComment: Intentionally omitted. The five documents are parallel convention/strategy commitments (climate, adaptation, nature, land), not a vision-and-derivatives hierarchy, so the Vision Anchor Coverage view stays off (same reasoning as Sri Lanka).
_documentTypesComment: Generic document-type names, not real national documents: Country X is fictional, so fullLabel is the plain convention/strategy document kind and no docKind/published/author/url metadata is set (omitted rather than fabricated). Colors reuse the established cross-country palette (NDC blue and NBSAP green match Sri Lanka / Côte d'Ivoire; LDN amber matches Sri Lanka); avoids reserved red (#dc2626 political sensitivity), BTR purple (#7c3aed), and OTHER grey (#78716c); mutually distinguishable.

_docProvenanceComment: Country X is fictional, so provenance states what each demonstration document actually is instead of citing a national source: real published policy-target text from one real country's document of this kind, de-identified (see ingest_countryx_14aug26.py for every edit).
